findings.title: G1 expectancy in margins_to_fail.jsonl is denominated over N+1=306 days while the emitted series has N=305 rows; terminal's 'recomputation matched the anchor margins exactly' is false for G1
findings.detail: Driver passes eligible[-1]+1 as the INCLUSIVE last_day to arm_metrics (run_v16_cell.py ~line 877), so expectancy divides by 306 while per_period_series.jsonl emits 305 rows; the extra day books exactly 0.0 (insensitive for PF/MDD/G3/G4, which is why those match to r12 exactly). Verified arithmetically: CDF fsum(series)/305 = +0.000176574013 vs margins file +0.000175996973 (= series sum/306 to 1e-12); RUNPERSIST -0.001465147635 vs -0.001460359571 (= series sum/306). The terminal report, ledger row, MAP entry, and failure-registry rows all quote -0.00146515/day - the SERIES value, which matches MY recompute - while the margins files they certify carry the 306-day value, so the report's 'gate_order_note' claim that margins were re-verified and 'matched exactly' is inaccurate for G1 (~0.33% relative discrepancy). VERDICT UNAFFECTED: G1 has no threshold but 0, both variants share sign (RUNPERSIST negative by 300x the discrepancy; CDF positive either way); first-fail order unchanged; REJECT_ALL monotone. Repair would be post-scored remediation territory (handbook 22) - recorded, not patched. RESOLVED BY DISCLOSURE here.
